t: Difference between "kaufen", "einkaufen", "aufkaufen" and "ankaufen"? | Wyzant Ask An Expert
s: March 15, 2019 - "Kaufen" means to buy, in the most general and non-specific sense. "Einkaufen" means to shop, or to purchase something by shopping. As we would say, "I shopped for shoes today." "Aufkaufen" means to "buy up," or to purchase a lot or all of something. "Ankaufen" is used rarely.
